title: Display
text: Connect the screen to the CPU. The CPU puts an address on addr and a byte on dout, with we at 1 through the clock cycle of a store. sptr is the screen pointer, 8 bits: a store to address 0xFE sets it to dout at the rising clk, and nothing else changes it. swe is 1 while a store to address 0xFD is under way, and 0 at any other time: the screen then takes dout at the byte sptr points to. A register is provided. The main sheet is the computer, with the screen on it: write a program that draws in Program's ROM to try yours.

runs.name: Two bytes
runs.source:
LDI 200
STA 0xFE
LDI 0xFF
STA 0xFD
LDI 7
STA 0xFE
LDI 0x0F
STA 0xFD
LDA 0xFE
OUT
HLT
